note: Authoritative frozen ownership data; packet-index links here. Maintainer-only spec/evidence-status edits are outside implementer allowlists. No packet is dispatched without explicit authorization. 2026-10-01: R13 added by operator-authorized amendment; Maintainer shared-interface amendments are listed in maintainer_amendments. 2026-10-02 (ADR 0009): R14a–R14f added for slice 015 (Phase 4), serial; allowlists are disjoint and proposed before dispatch. 2026-10-08 (ADR 0011, ADR 0012): R15a-R15d (Phase 5, serial) and R16a-R16e (Phase 6, serial) added; allowlists are disjoint from each other and from every earlier packet. Phase 6 may be built before Phase 5.

maintainer_amendments.change: Add the fixed permanova capability (Python map entry + R handler name), the optional multivariate configuration block and optional R Suggests.
Command-level integration seam for validate/plan/run/verify; planning stages carry plan_hash=null; report template packaged.
R01 regression tests that asserted 'not yet implemented' now simulate absence explicitly; their invariants are unchanged.
Spec checker accepts the amended 130-requirement/13-slice kit; explicit project-local R dependency installer.

Phase 2 integration: fixed report-section providers for response/pathways/assay engines; plan freezes DEqMS count-evidence hashes; the R05 score guard applies only to Phase 1 plans; workflow runs assay engines, resources, response and pathways; 'resources prepare' command; R01 doctor test simulates an absent resources module; oracle helper reads the last JSON line.

R10b activates the contracted 'report --run' and 'compare --left --right --output' commands; the workflow appends an optional report_full stage after the R10a stub; the R10a stage-order assertion allows that trailing stage (the stub report is otherwise unchanged).

R11 activates the contracted 'resume --run' command and lets the workflow reuse verified stage outputs through cache.py fingerprints (normalized request + code manifest + environment); any mismatch re-executes the stage and all dependants.

R04 V038 negative asserted that assay_engines was unimplemented; after R06 it simulates an absent assay_service module explicitly (same invariant: absent optional adapter is NOT_RUN, required one exits 3, never limma). Found by the 2026-10-02 full gate re-run.

The R01 CLI contract used a required DEqMS model as the still-unimplemented capability; after R06 the child process blocks the assay_service module explicitly (same invariant: validate/plan/run exit 3 with E_CAPABILITY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED). The same regression exposed an untyped missing-count-evidence error, fixed inside R06 (E_DEQMS_COUNT_EVIDENCE, exit 2).

Independent audit 2026-10-02 (MAJOR 1): configuration validation rejects a preprocessing sensitivity whose model_id is the role=primary model (E_SENSITIVITY_PRIMARY_MODEL, exit 2), so an imputed matrix can never feed the primary fit.

Portability fixes from the first real CI run (36982402784, V107 FAIL). runtime.run_r_code runs R snippets from a UTF-8 script file instead of `Rscript -e`, passes forward-slash path arguments and decodes as UTF-8. runtime.child_environment forces a UTF-8 locale for R children on POSIX. The CLI contract finds console scripts through sysconfig. Explicit encoding='utf-8' was added mechanically to every text-mode open/read_text/write_text/subprocess call across src/, tests/ and scripts/maintained/ (each file stays in its owning packet; behaviour is unchanged on UTF-8 platforms), and a lint test enforces it.

Portability follow-up to A-2026-10-01-11, found by the coordinator's simulated non-UTF-8 run (LC_ALL=C; non-ASCII paths) of the CI-failing tests: cli._emit printed JSON with ensure_ascii=False through the console encoding, so `proteomics report` (and any command whose payload holds non-ASCII text) crashed with UnicodeEncodeError on ASCII/cp1252 consoles. CLI output is now written to stdout as UTF-8 bytes regardless of locale. Regression test test_json_output_is_utf8_under_non_utf8_console fails on fd8dfa9 (exit 1, UnicodeEncodeError) and passes after the fix. Also: build_acceptance_ledger now writes a reason on FAIL records (taken from the traceability verification reason); V110 requires a reason on every non-PASS record and failed once V107 became FAIL. The ledger was regenerated: V107 gains its reason and V001's artifact hash follows the edited test_cli_contract.py; no status changed.

Re-review follow-ups of 2026-10-03 (decisions.md open item 12). D-42: platform-independent plan hash (LF-normalised content hashes for sources, planning artifacts and code; semantic plan hash with the solved environment and session information outside it, protected by integrity_sha256; R and intake text artifacts written UTF-8/LF; count_evidence by file name). D-43: PERMANOVA records N admissible relabellings and the minimum attainable P S/N, enumerates completely when N <= S x (nperm + 1), and never shows an unattainable floor with '<'; pairs involving an empty declared group are refused in refusals.tsv; SM27 amended. V059 setup failure is FAILED, never SKIPPED. Explicit UTF-8 R reads and LF writers; Rscript -e probes replaced by runtime.run_r_code; lint extended to direct subprocess imports, tempfile text modes, -e argv lists and R sources. PowerShell demo block and a cross-platform V100. Each fix has a test that fails on 106fb20 and passes after (docs/validation/review-2026-10-03).

Phase 4 shared interfaces (ADR 0009, before R14a): six capability IDs (post_de_sets/sensitivity/association/biomarker/networks/eligibility) in the fixed Python map; the five R-backed ones in the R dispatch map (post_de_eligibility is Python-only, like report_full); optional post_de configuration block per contracts/post-de.md with runtime.phase 4 (Phase 1-3 configurations cannot enable it: schema rule plus typed E_PHASE_CAPABILITY precheck); resource kind 'ppi' with score_type; requested_phase 4 in run-status/report-data schemas; design_service.replan (named secondary designs through the same grammar with exact rational rank and estimability) and exact_rank; workflow: typed post-DE precheck, requested capabilities, plan-time eligibility recorded in the capability plan (SM41; required ineligible modules reject the plan), dispatch R14a-R14e in order then R14f; validation-cohort paths enter the plan by name; fixed report-section providers for every post-DE module; R Suggests glmnet, pROC, e1071, randomForest, dynamicTreeCut (installed in .r-lib and pinned in renv.lock with their dependencies foreach, iterators, shape, RcppEigen, proxy); WGCNA is not used (D-44).

R14b integration: a required post-DE module may publish required_refusal(decision); when a declared sub-analysis of a required module is ineligible (for example a non-estimable interaction, E_SENSITIVITY_NONESTIMABLE) the plan is rejected (exit 2) before any fit (V137 negative). Optional modules record the refusal and run the remaining analyses. Allowlist amendment: plan.md requires one synthetic design factory reused by every R14 packet, so tests/fixtures/post_de/design_factory.py (created by R14a) is added to the R14b-R14f allowlists; each packet appends its own generator functions and changes no existing one.

R14c re-plan API extension: design_service.replan(..., group_term=False) drops the group coefficients for pooled unadjusted and within-group phenotype designs (interactions with group are then refused, E_DESIGN_TERM); exact rank and estimability are computed on the reduced design.

R14d: optional post_de.biomarker.classifier_params (fixed lambda grid for penalised logistic, cost grid for SVM; default grids are derived in-fold); R11 lock qualification probes the glmnet and e1071 APIs the biomarker stage calls.

R14e: R07 snapshot kind 'ppi' (columns gene_a, gene_b, score; the preparation manifest must record score_type, which is kept in the snapshot and checked against the declared resource; target taxonomy must equal the study organism); a resource path naming a remote location fails E_RESOURCE_DOWNLOAD before analysis (analysis never downloads); the shared post-DE input check (R14a .pd_verify_inputs) accepts resource_/resfile_ inputs, which verify_resources and the hash-on-read rule already verify; optional co-abundance cut_height.

R14e follow-up (found by the R14f generality matrix): limma drops the row names of a one-row fit, so fit_limma_model failed in moderation_diagnostics for a model with exactly one eligible feature (a single co-abundance module); the row names of the full fit are restored from the tested universe. Fail-before/pass-after: test-post-de-networks.R 'V163 a single module ...'.

Calibration extension for R14d/R14e (spec 015 plan: 'recorded in R14f'): the post-DE calibration runner, its R driver and its evidence test are added to the R14f allowlist. Gates were fixed before the first run (D-52).

R12: write_acceptance_ledger keeps each R12 row's recorded NOT_RUN reason (Maintainer-only private gate, operator decision, final review) instead of overwriting all ten with one generic sentence; the generic text remains the fallback. Fail-before/pass-after: tests/regression/test_traceability_reconciliation.py (V116). The traceability identity note now records the ADR 0009 identities.

Fixes for the independent review of 106fb20..7bce0fd (2026-10-05, docs/validation/review-2026-10-05) inside the R14c, R14d, R14e, R14f and R12 allowlists after their receipts; the only path outside them is the R11 lint test, extended with an LF rule for release-artifact writers. Decisions D-54 to D-57.
